phases.name: FATF EDD and KYC Assessment
phases.description: The Treasury team (PER-053) identifies the need for a new correspondent banking relationship. The Compliance team (SVC-015) conducts FATF Recommendation 13 Enhanced Due Diligence: SWIFT KYC Registry lookup, regulatory status verification, AML controls review, sanctions screening programme assessment. SVC-014 runs sanctions screening on the correspondent bank entity. A CorrespondentRelationship record is created in status = under_assessment. Senior Management approval is required per MLR 2017 Regulation 34.
entry_conditions: Business case approved for new currency corridor
Correspondent bank identified and SWIFT KYC Registry entry verified

phases.name: Senior Management Approval
phases.description: The Head of Compliance (SMF16) and MLRO (SMF17) review the EDD documentation and risk assessment. Senior Management approval obtained per MLR 2017 Regulation 34 requirement. CorrespondentRelationship updated to status = approved.
actors: PER-059 (Senior Manager — Head of Compliance / MLRO)
entry_conditions: EDD documentation complete with no unresolved red flags

phases.name: Nostro Account Setup and SWIFT Registration
phases.description: The Treasury team (SVC-007) creates the nostro account for the new correspondent relationship. SWIFT BIC for the correspondent is registered in the payment routing table (SVC-010). A test SWIFT MT202 message is exchanged to confirm the channel is live.
exit_conditions: Correspondent BIC registered in payment routing table (SVC-010)

phases.name: Annual EDD Review Scheduling
phases.description: The Compliance system (SVC-015) schedules the annual EDD review for the new correspondent relationship per MLR 2017 Regulation 34 ongoing monitoring requirement. CorrespondentRelationship updated to status = active. Annual review due date set to 12 months from onboarding date.
entry_conditions: Nostro account and SWIFT channel confirmed live
exit_conditions: Annual EDD review scheduled for next year

happy_path.description: Treasury identifies new corridor → Compliance conducts FATF R13 EDD → Senior Management approves → nostro account set up and SWIFT registered → test message exchanged → relationship live.

alternative_paths.name: EDD Red Flag — Enhanced Review
alternative_paths.description: EDD identifies a red flag (e.g. correspondent bank in a FATF grey-listed jurisdiction). Enhanced review required. Senior Management risk decision documented. Relationship may proceed with enhanced monitoring controls or be rejected.
alternative_paths.diverges_at: PH-127: EDD identifies a FATF grey-list or elevated-risk indicator

exception_paths.name: Sanctions Hit — Relationship Rejected
exception_paths.description: Sanctions screening (SVC-014) identifies a positive hit against the correspondent bank entity or its beneficial owners. CorrespondentRelationship set to status = rejected. EVT-163 not published. OFSI/FCA notified if required. Relationship cannot proceed.
exception_paths.diverges_at: PH-127: SVC-014 sanctions screening returns a positive hit

design_decisions.decision: CorrespondentRelationship entity is owned by SVC-015 (Compliance Core, CAP-005) as the regulatory accountability system. The nostro account is owned by SVC-007 (Treasury Services, CAP-002). The payment routing BIC registration is owned by SVC-010 (International Payments, CAP-003).
design_decisions.rationale: Three distinct domain concerns: regulatory EDD (CAP-005), treasury account management (CAP-002), payment routing (CAP-003). Each capability owns its respective data.
design_decisions.alternatives_considered: Single entity spanning all three — rejected as it would create cross-capability data ownership.
